grammarFocus: 让步、条件、因果；复杂句和简单句的清楚组合。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. title: Riverbend's Plastic Fee: A Policy at Three Scales
instructions: 本材料为原创模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题，也不对应任何官方分数。请先听/读全文，再完成10道题。听力部分注意不同说话人之间的自然接话与修正；阅读部分注意段落A/B/C。语法部分先用中文理解“让步、条件、因果”的表达，再完成8道新句子的选择题。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。
transcript:
Maya: Okay, everyone, thanks for coming. This is the Riverbend town council's informal session on the proposed plastic bag fee. I'm Maya, the council's policy analyst. Let's start with the town level. If we introduce a five-cent fee per bag, we expect shops to reduce bag use by about thirty percent in the first year. That's a conditional claim, not a promise.

Daniel: Sorry, Maya, can I push back on that? Thirty percent sounds high. In other towns, the drop was closer to fifteen percent. So unless we add a public information campaign, I doubt we'll hit thirty.

Maya: Fair point, Daniel. Let me correct myself. The thirty percent figure assumes a campaign. Without one, fifteen percent is more realistic. So the condition matters.

Priya: I'm Priya from the Riverbend Retail Association. Even if the fee is small, our members worry about paperwork. Although the fee is only five cents, the reporting form is two pages long. That's a burden for small shops, especially those with limited staff and resources.

Maya: That's a valid concern. We could simplify the form. If the form is one page, compliance should improve. And because small shops have fewer staff, a simple form helps them most. We should also consider offering online submission to reduce administrative work.

Daniel: But what about the regional level? The county wants a uniform rule. If Riverbend acts alone, shoppers may drive to the next town to avoid the fee. That's leakage. And leakage means we lose both revenue and environmental benefits.

Priya: Exactly. So even though a town fee is popular, a county-wide rule would be more effective. Although it's harder to pass, it closes the leakage gap. Our members would rather have one consistent rule across the county than a patchwork of local fees.

Maya: Right. So the town fee works only if neighboring towns cooperate. Otherwise, the environmental gain is smaller than we hope. We should coordinate with county officials to align our timelines.

Daniel: And the state level? The state is considering a ban on thin plastic bags altogether. If the state bans them, the town fee becomes irrelevant for those bags. But a ban would also require enforcement and public education.

Maya: True. But a state ban takes two years. So in the short term, the town fee still matters. Because the state timeline is slow, local action fills the gap. We can also use the town fee as a pilot to inform state policy.

Priya: Our members would accept a town fee if the state ban is coming. They prefer one clear rule to three confusing ones. Although they dislike fees, they dislike uncertainty more. A clear timeline from the state would help them plan.

Maya: Good. So here's the summary. The town fee reduces bags only if we run a campaign and simplify the form. The county rule is stronger because it prevents leakage. The state ban is the cleanest, but it is slow. Since each scale has a different speed, we should act at the town level now and support the county and state plans. This layered approach ensures we make progress while avoiding confusion.

Daniel: One more correction. Earlier I said fifteen percent without a campaign. Actually, the study said twelve percent. So twelve, not fifteen. I apologize for the error.

Maya: Thanks, Daniel. Twelve percent without a campaign, thirty with one. Let's note that. Any final questions? No? Then we'll draft the proposal. Thanks, everyone.

questions.prompt: What does Maya first say the town fee will do?
options: Reduce bag use by about thirty percent in the first year, if there is a campaign.
Ban all plastic bags in the town immediately.
Increase shop profits by five cents per bag.
Replace the county rule with a state law.
answers: Reduce bag use by about thirty percent in the first year, if there is a campaign.
questions.explanation: Maya 明确说：如果引入五美分费用，并假设有宣传活动，第一年塑料袋使用量预计减少约30%。这是条件性说法。
questions.evidence: If we introduce a five-cent fee per bag, we expect shops to reduce bag use by about thirty percent in the first year.

questions.prompt: Daniel corrects a number. What is the final figure without a campaign?
questions.explanation: Daniel 先说是15%，后来明确修正为12%：'Actually, the study said twelve percent. So twelve, not fifteen.' 因此最终数字是12%。
questions.evidence: Actually, the study said twelve percent. So twelve, not fifteen.

questions.prompt: Why do small shops worry about the fee?
options: Because the reporting form is two pages long.
Because the fee is too high for customers.
Because the county rule is unclear.
Because the state ban is too slow.
answers: Because the reporting form is two pages long.
questions.explanation: Priya 说小商店担心文书工作：费用虽小，但报告表有两页长，对小店是负担。
questions.evidence: Although the fee is only five cents, the reporting form is two pages long.

questions.prompt: What is Daniel's concern about Riverbend acting alone?
options: Shoppers may drive to the next town to avoid the fee.
The town will lose money on the campaign.
The state will ban bags too quickly.
answers: Shoppers may drive to the next town to avoid the fee.
questions.explanation: Daniel 担心如果 Riverbend 单独行动，购物者可能开车去邻镇避费，造成“泄漏”。
questions.evidence: If Riverbend acts alone, shoppers may drive to the next town to avoid the fee.

questions.prompt: According to Priya, why would a county-wide rule be more effective?
options: Because it closes the leakage gap.
Because it is easier to pass than a town fee.
Because it costs nothing for shops.
answers: Because it closes the leakage gap.
questions.explanation: Priya 说虽然全县规则更难通过，但它能堵住泄漏缺口，因此更有效。
questions.evidence: Although it's harder to pass, it closes the leakage gap.

questions.prompt: What does Maya say about the state ban's timing?
options: It takes two years, so the town fee still matters in the short term.
It will start next week, so the town fee is useless.
It is faster than the county rule.
answers: It takes two years, so the town fee still matters in the short term.
questions.explanation: Maya 说州禁令需要两年，因此短期内镇费用仍然重要，地方行动可以填补空档。
questions.evidence: But a state ban takes two years. So in the short term, the town fee still matters.

questions.prompt: What do Priya's members prefer, according to her?
options: One clear rule rather than three confusing ones.
Three separate rules at each level.
A rule that changes every month.
answers: One clear rule rather than three confusing ones.
questions.explanation: Priya 说成员更愿意接受一个清晰的规则，而不是三个令人困惑的规则。
questions.evidence: They prefer one clear rule to three confusing ones.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the talk: The town fee reduces bags only if we run a campaign and ______ the form.
questions.explanation: Maya 总结说，镇费用只有在开展宣传活动并简化表格时才会减少袋子。原文用 'simplify the form'。
questions.evidence: The town fee reduces bags only if we run a campaign and simplify the form.

questions.prompt: Which statement is TRUE according to the talk?
options: Maya accepts Daniel's correction about the figure.
Daniel says the study found thirty percent without a campaign.
Priya says the county rule is easier to pass.
Maya says the state ban will start in two months.
answers: Maya accepts Daniel's correction about the figure.
questions.explanation: Maya 回应 Daniel 的修正说 'Thanks, Daniel. Twelve percent without a campaign, thirty with one.' 表明她接受了修正。其他选项与原文矛盾。
questions.evidence: Thanks, Daniel. Twelve percent without a campaign, thirty with one.

options: Act at the town level now and support the county and state plans.
Wait two years for the state ban and do nothing now.
Cancel the town fee because the county disagrees.
Ask shops to write three separate reports.
answers: Act at the town level now and support the county and state plans.
questions.explanation: Maya 总结说每个层级速度不同，因此应现在在镇一级行动，同时支持县和州的计划。
questions.evidence: Since each scale has a different speed, we should act at the town level now and support the county and state plans.

vocabulary.example: That's a conditional claim, not a promise.
So unless we add a public information campaign, I doubt we'll hit thirty.
If the form is one page, compliance should improve.

vocabulary.meaning: 泄漏（此处指消费者流向邻镇避费）

vocabulary.example: The county wants a uniform rule.

grammar.title: 让步、条件、因果：让复杂句和简单句清楚组合
grammar.explanation: 英语里表达逻辑关系常用三类连接词。条件：if / unless / only if，表示“如果/除非/只有在……才”。让步：although / even if / even though，表示“虽然/即使”，主句仍然成立。因果：because / since / so，表示“因为/既然/所以”。写作时不必每句都复杂：先用简单句把事实说清，再用一个复杂句补充条件或让步，读者更容易跟上。注意：although 和 but 不同时用；because 和 so 不同时用。
grammar.example: Although the fee is only five cents, the reporting form is two pages long.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: ______ the fee is small, many shoppers still notice it.
questions.explanation: 前后是让步关系：“虽然费用小，购物者仍然注意到”。Although 引导让步状语从句。
questions.evidence: Although the fee is only five cents, the reporting form is two pages long.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: We will not reach the target ______ we run a campaign.
questions.explanation: unless = if not，“除非我们开展宣传活动，否则达不到目标”。
questions.evidence: So unless we add a public information campaign, I doubt we'll hit thirty.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: The form is short, ______ compliance should improve.
questions.explanation: 前因后果：“表格短，所以合规应改善”。so 连接结果。
questions.evidence: If the form is one page, compliance should improve.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: ______ the county rule is harder to pass, it closes the leakage gap.
questions.explanation: 前后是让步：“尽管全县规则更难通过，它能堵住泄漏”。Even though 比 although 语气更强。
questions.evidence: Although it's harder to pass, it closes the leakage gap.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: The state ban is slow; ______, the town fee still matters now.
questions.explanation: therefore 表示因果结果：“州禁令慢，因此镇费用现在仍重要”。
questions.evidence: Because the state timeline is slow, local action fills the gap.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: ______ we act alone, shoppers may drive to the next town.
questions.explanation: 条件关系：“如果我们单独行动，购物者可能去邻镇”。If 引导条件从句。
questions.evidence: If Riverbend acts alone, shoppers may drive to the next town to avoid the fee.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: ______ small shops have fewer staff, a simple form helps them most.
questions.explanation: 因果关系：“因为小商店员工少，简单表格对他们帮助最大”。
questions.evidence: And because small shops have fewer staff, a simple form helps them most.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: The town fee works ______ neighboring towns cooperate.
questions.explanation: only if 表示“只有在……才”，强调必要条件：“只有邻镇合作，镇费用才有效”。
questions.evidence: So the town fee works only if neighboring towns cooperate.
